newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher on funds buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher on funds buying.

text.p: Persistent buying by foreign institutional investors and local mutual funds pushed Delhi shares to a higher close, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 4.26 points higher at 737.97.
ACC lost 5.05 rupees to 1,554, while Hindustan Lever quoted 6.50 rupees lower at 809.
ITC ended up five rupees at 315, and Reliance Industries gained 4.25 rupees to 212.
State Bank of India quoted 8.55 rupees higher at 232.05. Larsen and Toubro rose eight rupees to 233.
